title: Chapter 1420
text:
The Arcane Church did not deliberately block the news. The news of Wuornos' failure to advance quickly spread among the upper echelons. The Radiant Federation, the Red Empire, and many Beyond Grade As learned of this matter. Their reactions were different. Some were surprised, some were regretful, and many were gloating.

Originally, after Black Star opened the Transcendent Grade, many Beyond Grade As also had thoughts of advancing. However, with Wuornos' example, many people temporarily suppressed their desires.

Even Wuornos, who was currently second, had failed. It was better to wait and see.

Because of this, many Beyond Grade As also confirmed that Black Star was the only Transcendent in the short term. For the time being, no one else had the ability to break through to this level, and their position was unshakable. This made them even more eager to learn about the advancement method that Black Star had not revealed.

However, these things were only spread among the upper echelons. The masses of the galactic society knew nothing about it and were still living a tight wartime life.

However, a few days later, a piece of news from the Black Star Corps quickly spread throughout the galactic society, causing an uproar on the internet and attracting the attention of countless galactic residents.

Black Star, who had been keeping a low profile for a period of time, suddenly made a big move. In the name of the Beyond Grade A Association and the three Universal Civilizations, he publicly sent out invitations. His target was the various organizations in the entire universe. There were civilizations and civilian organizations. The number was shocking, covering almost all regions.

Black Star expressed in the letter that he was prepared to hold a meeting and invite the representatives of the various organizations to discuss the development prospects of the explored universe and the disadvantages of the human trade.

Now that Han Xiao's every move was being watched by the galactic residents and the various large organizations, this action immediately caused a heated discussion. Countless people were puzzled and guessed the deeper meaning of Black Star's actions.

The enemy was approaching step by step, and the situation of the war was not optimistic. Many people did not understand why Black Star would emphasize the issue of human trade at this juncture.

Wasn't the war the most important thing now? Even if one had to settle the internal affairs before dealing with foreign enemies, it did not seem to have much to do with the human trade.

Furthermore, a meeting of this level almost included all the famous organizations in the universe, so it should be led by the three Universal Civilizations. Why was it Black Star this time, and the meeting location was even in the territory of the Black Star Corps?

Many people could not help but think … Does this mean that Black Star has the same authority as the three Universal Civilizations? Was Black Star's status already so high?!

Although they were doubtful, the various organizations still gave him face. The various civilizations responded publicly, expressing that they would accept the invitation to attend the conference. Countless private organizations also expressed through various channels that it was their honor to receive Black Star's invitation, treating it as an honor.

All of a sudden, the galactic society, which had been quiet for a long time, was in turmoil. It was as if Black Star was the leader of the Galactic Alliance, and his reputation was unparalleled.

With Han Xiao's current status, not many organizations that wanted to survive in the galactic society dared to not give him face. The power of the Face Fruit was already at its peak.

Under the watchful eyes of the public, time passed day by day, and the day of the meeting arrived as scheduled.

…

Outside the Black Star Palace, a large venue that had been hastily built was suspended between the fortresses like a flat top. Its silver-gray shell reflected the light of the stars.

Streams of light gathered from all directions, forming light dragons. Spaceships with the emblems of different organizations sailed into the spaceport one after another, and representatives of different appearances and costumes walked down one after another.

The dock platform was already packed with people. Countless reception robots were shuttling through the crowd, leading the way for the representatives of different organizations. Some organizations that were too far away used remote projections, but there were also many organizations that sent people there personally to give Black Star face.

"So many people have come …"

The Amethyst Civilization's diplomatic group walked down from the spaceship. Ralph, who was in the lead, looked at the crowded scene in front of him, and a smile appeared on his wrinkled face.

This time, a young diplomat beside him came up to him curiously and whispered, "Old Leader, you've been through a lot.

I heard that you used to have a good relationship with Black Star? "

"It's alright, but I haven't seen him in a long time … After so many years, he's doing really well. He's no longer on the same level as me."

A complicated look flashed across Ralph's eyes. He waved his hands and sighed.

Back during the secret war of the Crimson Tide, the Black Star Corps had accepted the invitation of the Amethyst Civilization as one of the mercenaries to fight against the invasion of the Klent Kingdom and Bloodshed Land together. At that time, he had been the commander of Section Zero of the Secret Service and had been in charge of liaising with Black Star. They had known each other for many years.

Because of this relationship, Purple Crystal had allowed Ralph to lead the team to participate in this meeting. However, decades had passed, and he was now old and about to retire. The power in his hands was about to end, but Black Star, who had worked with him back then, had become more and more active. He had gone from a small mercenary to an existence that the Amethyst Civilization could not afford to associate with. The two different lives made him have mixed feelings.

This time, a discordant voice suddenly sounded from the side.

"Isn't this the representative of the Amethyst Civilization? I didn't expect to meet you here."

The Amethyst Civilization's delegation turned around and saw a group of people getting off the spaceship. It was the Klent Kingdom's delegation.

The two parties were still not on good terms after the end of the secret war, and there were many grudges between them. Now that the delegations from both parties met, they looked at each other coldly as if they did not like each other.

"Humph, so it's the Klent emissary." Ralph glanced at him and said calmly, "It's been decades, and you guys are still the same. You hate Black Star, but you don't dare to reject his invitation. I advise you to keep a low profile and be a good kid in Black Star's territory. Don't cause trouble."

The Klent emissary's veins bulged. He was about to retort when he saw the Black Star Corps' reception robot flying over. He quickly shut his mouth and only dared to glare at Ralph.

Ralph had been in a high position for many years and had interacted with Klent countless times. He did not take a young emissary seriously at all. He turned around and looked at the different delegations.

Compared to the civilizations' delegations, the number of delegations from the private organizations was thousands of times greater. Most of them were representatives from the private organizations. Many of them looked very cautious. Clearly, it was their first time participating in an event of this scale, so they pretended to be calm and did not want to show their fear.

"One invitation and almost all the organizations in the universe are here … Black Star's position is really unparalleled."

What does it mean to command the universe? This is what it means to command the universe …

Ralph sighed and followed the reception robot into the venue with his subordinates.

At this moment, the venue was already filled with countless representatives. They were whispering to each other and had all kinds of strange appearances. It was like an intergalactic species expo. The media was not absent either. They were adjusting their equipment and preparing to broadcast the event.

The Beyond Grade As, who were rarely seen, were all sitting in rows at the front, receiving the attention of the delegations. The emissaries of the various advanced civilizations and important private organizations were also waiting in the core area.

Almost all the organizations with a name had arrived. It was an unprecedented occasion!

After waiting for a while, all the representatives of the organizations were seated. There were no empty seats, and no one had yet to arrive. Only then did the door of the venue slowly close.

The venue slowly quieted down. Soon, it was completely silent.

This time, a figure walked out of the shadows on the stage and quickly appeared in front of everyone, attracting everyone's attention.

Han Xiao came to the podium, glanced at the seats that were almost endless, smiled, and slowly said, "Thank you for accepting my invitation.

On behalf of the Beyond Grade A Association and the three Universal Civilizations, I welcome your arrival. This meeting is held during this special period mainly to discuss the development prospects of the galactic society. "

Clap clap clap!

Everyone clapped and pricked up their ears, curious about Black Star's intentions.

Han Xiao raised his hand, stopped smiling, and solemnly said, "Since the beginning of the galactic society, the galactic society has been developing.

"Since the development of the galactic era, our civilization has created countless brilliant results in various fields. The galactic society is extremely prosperous, but at the same time, it has accumulated countless drawbacks. The human trade is a problem that has existed throughout history.

The obedience of others is one of the core cornerstones of power, so enslaving others is an eternal desire. Demand brings a market, and no matter how we attack it, the human trade can never be eliminated. After failing again and again, we got used to it, tolerated it, and finally convinced ourselves that this is an unsolvable problem, giving up the idea of completely solving it.

However, now that the situation in the galaxy has changed, our control over the various Star Fields is highly condensed. This is an opportunity to clean up the roots, so I hope to get your help to solve the drawbacks of the human trade together. "

Hearing this, the representatives were a little stunned and looked at each other.

They had thought that Black Star had other plans for holding the meeting, and the human trade was just a reason. They did not expect Black Star to really want to solve this problem.

"This …"

Everyone was confused.

It seemed like the existence of the human trade did not affect Black Star at all, right? Was there a need to use his reputation to call all of them over just for this matter?

What was Black Star planning? What benefits did this kind of thankless thing have for him?

If it was just to increase his reputation, there were plenty of ways. Why did he choose this troublesome path?

On the stage, Han Xiao took in everyone's puzzled expressions. He let out a sigh and said solemnly,

He exhaled deeply and said, "I know that you might think that the interstellar human trade has nothing to do with me and are wondering what benefits I can gain from it … To be honest, with my status, the existence of the human trade has no right to affect my interests. It's dispensable, but why did I hold a meeting for this matter?

Everyone, although the progress of the era mainly comes from the push of a few people, the main body of the world is still the most ordinary galactic residents. Because of their existence, our universe is so prosperous, and we have the name of civilization.

Over the years, the human trade has caused countless tragedies. Although it does not threaten us, we should not turn a blind eye to it. We are used to standing at the top, but no matter how high we stand, we have to lower our heads at the right time to look at the dark corners and the situation of ordinary people.

The meaning of our existence is not only for ourselves but also for the mission of promoting the development of the world. We have the ability to make the galactic society better and create a better world. "

As soon as he said that, many people present trembled. They did not expect Black Star to say such a thing.

For a moment, everyone was stunned. They felt that Han Xiao on the stage seemed to be emitting the light of humanity.

Some people were excited, some were impressed, some scoffed, and some were suspicious.

Was Black Star serious?

Was it a noble sentiment of boundless love or a show to leave a mark in history?

After a moment of silence, an emissary of the Supercluster civilization suddenly asked, "The war situation is still very tense.

"Right now, the war situation is still very grim. Isn't it too early to mention this matter? If we can't chase away the enemy, everything will be in vain. "

Han Xiao only glanced at him indifferently and said calmly, "It's precisely because we are confident that we can win this war that we don't want to let go of this opportunity to eliminate the drawbacks. Everything is for the future."

As soon as he said that, everyone was energized.

Black Star's tone was very calm, but it was like a reassuring pill that excited most of the people present.

Now, all the organizations in the universe were worried about where the war would end. At this moment, a big shot like Black Star had come out to express his stance. Whether it was the truth or comfort, it was a boost to morale.

Especially when they thought of Black Star's goal this time, they felt a strong sense of confidence … If not for hope for the future, why would he spend so much effort to cure the long-standing drawbacks of the galactic society? Wasn't this all for the sake of ruling after winning the war?

All sorts of thoughts flashed through everyone's minds.

Suddenly, a representative of a private organization stood up and said loudly, "Your Excellency Black Star, you care about the common people. We admire your character and are willing to serve you!"

All of a sudden, the representatives of the various organizations seemed to have woken up from a dream and expressed their stance enthusiastically. The venue instantly became lively, and buzzing sounds could be heard.

Although Black Star's words were pleasant to hear, it was unrealistic to want to convince those with vested interests with just a few words. Many organizations finally agreed to cooperate because of Black Star.

The main reason for this was that Black Star had used his reputation to gather everyone and opened up the communication barrier between them. Coupled with his sufficient appeal, the matter was settled … If not for Black Star taking the lead and someone else saying this, they would not have taken action even if they were moved.

Anyone could speak the truth. It did not matter if it was nice or not. What mattered was who said it.

Many organizations were willing to help Han Xiao achieve this goal. On the one hand, it was politically correct. On the other hand, it was a grand event. There was no need to let go of this opportunity to increase their reputation … Lastly, it might be mixed with some respect for Han Xiao.

…

This scene was also broadcasted by countless media outlets and landed in the eyes of countless galactic residents.

"Oh my god …"

"What is Black Star doing?"

Countless galactic residents were dumbfounded.

Black Star's statement completely exceeded the expectations of countless people. They did not expect Black Star to have such a far-reaching goal.

They did not know the twists and turns behind the scenes. All they saw was the surface.

Seeing that Black Star was able to pull so many organizations to work together to stop the human trade, his influence was comparable to the three Universal Civilizations.

In the eyes of the galactic residents, Han Xiao's image instantly became even greater. Radiance radiated from his body, completely solidifying his position as the number one person in the explored universe.

"Creating a better galactic society … Black Star actually has such a spirit …"

"Well said. This world should become more beautiful."

While countless people were shocked, they could not help but feel touched. They did not expect someone like Black Star to still care about ordinary people like them.

Human trafficking was like a deep nightmare, enough to wake any ordinary person up in the middle of the night with cold sweat.

There were millions of races in the galaxy, and outsiders would always arouse curiosity. No one could guarantee that they would never become prey in the eyes of others.

In their eyes, regardless of whether Black Star's motives were pure or not, as long as he stood up and did something, he was worthy of being respected from the bottom of his heart.

If not for Black Star standing up for him, this would not have happened.

The news was broadcasted again and again, leaving a deep impression in the hearts of more and more galactic residents. Han Xiao's reputation was also brought to an unprecedented height.

"The existence of a person like Black Star might really make the world a better place …"

One galactic resident after another could not help but have such thoughts.

Some even felt that it was not bad to let Black Star rule the galactic society …
